products.label: A
products.reason: A star tracker is essentially the same kind of spacecraft attitude sensor as the firm's earlier star sensor products.

products.label: B
products.reason: A navigation camera serves the same spacecraft navigation and imaging customers, but it is a broader product than the earlier sensors and cameras.

products.label: C
products.reason: This is an exact repeat of the previously offered compact space camera.

products.label: D
products.reason: A thermal infrared camera extends the existing imaging-camera line into a different spectral band.

products.label: E
products.reason: An optical testing service builds directly on the firm's existing star sensor test devices and simulators, but it is a service rather than hardware.

products.label: F
products.reason: Quantum key distribution is a communications and security subsystem, which is far from the firm's earlier sensor and camera products.
